title: Azure Security and Identity
description: Learn Azure identity management with Entra ID, role-based access control, Key Vault, Microsoft Defender, and Sentinel SIEM.
longDescription: This module covers Azure's security and identity foundation. You will learn how Entra ID manages users and applications, how RBAC enforces least-privilege access, how Key Vault protects secrets and keys, and how Microsoft Defender for Cloud and Microsoft Sentinel provide threat detection and response.
whatYouLearn: Create and manage tenants, users, and groups in Entra ID
Apply RBAC roles at the right scope
Store secrets, keys, and certificates in Key Vault
Use managed identities to avoid hardcoding credentials
Monitor threats with Microsoft Defender for Cloud
